claim: For 3-union-free 3-uniform hypergraphs on 10 vertices, \(U_3(10,3)=8\), and every 8-edge extremal family is, up to relabeling, the pair-star consisting of all triples containing one fixed pair.
integrity: The finite upper bound and extremal classification were replayed from the embedded deterministic exhaustive verifier; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact result for ten vertices only; no claim for larger orders or asymptotics. Bibliographic novelty is supported by targeted searches and full-text comparison of the principal literature, but older coding-theory tables under alternate terminology remain a residual risk.
title: Exact order-ten 3-union-free triple systems
